rows.description: When to show full health details.
rows.why: Whether the health endpoint says which component is unhealthy, and to whom.
The port the application listens on.

rows.description: Session timeout. If a duration suffix is not specified, seconds will be used.
rows.why: How long an idle session lives.

rows.description: Type of shutdown that the server will support.
rows.why: Whether requests in flight are allowed to finish when the application stops.

rows.description: Maximum amount of worker threads. Doesn't have an effect if virtual threads are enabled.
rows.why: The most requests served at the same time; further requests queue.
Milliseconds a request waits for a database connection before it fails.
At most this many database connections. When all are in use, the next request waits.

rows.description: Timeout for the shutdown of any phase (group of SmartLifecycle beans with the same 'phase' value).
rows.why: How long a graceful shutdown waits for requests in flight.

rows.description: Whether initialization should be performed lazily.
rows.why: Whether beans are created at startup or on first use; lazy hides a wiring error until the first request that needs the bean.

rows.description: Whether RFC 9457 Problem Details support should be enabled.
rows.why: Whether errors are returned in the standard problem-details format.
An upload larger than this is rejected.

rows.description: Core number of threads. Doesn't have an effect if virtual threads are enabled.
rows.why: Threads kept for @Async and other background tasks.
Whether requests and tasks run on virtual threads.

rows.description: Default transaction timeout. If a duration suffix is not specified, seconds will be used.
rows.why: No timeout: a transaction runs as long as it takes unless one is set on it.
